title: A bound start for BCL-xL design
subtitle: Fragment linking viewed from the 3SPF crystal structure

cues.title: A crystallographic starting point
cues.body: Compound 4 occupies the BCL-xL binding groove in the published 3SPF structure.

cues.title: Enter the groove
cues.body: The bound ligand and its local receptor environment become the design workspace.
cues.detail: Complete crystallographic ligand · 5 Å residue shell

cues.title: Linking is a spatial hypothesis
cues.body: The medicinal-chemistry campaign tested whether linked recognition elements could preserve biochemical affinity and improve the series.
cues.detail: The later analogue graphs remain literature records; no uncurated pose is drawn

cues.title: Potency was not the only gate
cues.body: Some potent biochemical designs were not progressed because their cellular translation was weak.
cues.detail: Rejected branches remain part of the campaign history

cues.title: Structure and decision remain distinct
cues.body: Molarium shows the exact 3SPF coordinates and links later decisions to their sources without inventing missing experimental poses.
cues.detail: Actual structure · explicit evidence boundary · retained negative decisions
